quote: Mats is what your own disenchants of such items gave
notes: Distinct new Retail 12.1.5 addon source, not a numerical trial. Publisher describes a per-gear disenchant decision window learned from one's own disenchant outcomes. This proves advertised personal valuation learning, NOT a publicly accessible raw player event log, zero-inclusive sample, item-bonus or ilvl at cast, skill/spec, material rank or 0/1/2 histogram. GoldCap Companion public README says its optional paired upload handles sales/listings/prices from SavedVariables, not that per-cast DE observations are published or exported. Do not import simulated values, appraisal prices, or any purported probability. Github code-search check for GoldCap-addon-v0.29.0 and publisher quote yielded no prior exact source in this repository. Existing GatherBuffs lead and old Cardinalai/Honeybone/MikiMM/JD3K/Looter studies deliberately not duplicated. Requires publisher consent and anonymized original gear-itemLink to actual material-output event receipts (including failed/aborted and per-output zeros).
lookingFor: New independent current Retail Midnight 12.1.5 original zero-inclusive disenchanting per-cast samples by exact gear itemLink, item level, build, skill and specialization (272246), plus rank-specific 237362 prospecting/242608 unlock and 237359/237365 ore and 236761 milling completed-event ledgers.
